title: sdks: auth/retries + streaming parity & ergonomics bump v1.148.0
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Bumps SDKs to v1.148.0 with unified auth/retries behavior, streaming API parity fixes, and ergonomics improvements across Python/TS/Go.
description: Unify SDK auth/retries behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go and bring streaming APIs to parity for v1.148.0. Motivation: observed inconsistent retry semantics (token refresh vs network retries) across language SDKs and subtle differences in streaming framing/partial-chunk handling that caused duplicated or dropped events in customer integrations. This PR standardizes the default auth token refresh flow, centralizes retry/backoff logic, fixes streaming boundary handling in TS/Go to match Python's robust framing, and includes several ergonomics improvements (clearer error types, unified method names, and safer cancellation hooks). Changes include package version bumps to v1.148.0, updated CHANGELOGs, and extended integration smoke tests. Checklist: [x] unit + integration tests added/updated; [x] changelogs and migration notes; [x] Linear links referenced (ENG-1423, PM-88); [x] docs snippets for new retry config. CI: full matrix (py/ts/go) run; initial flaky TS streaming test failed on first run (streaming-chunk-boundary-test), reran and passed after small timing adjustment. Merge notes: squashed commit, bump tags applied, published packages to internal registry and updated docs site.

notes: This is a cross-SDK consistency PR; consumers upgrading from <v1.140.0 should read the migration guide for RetryConfig changes. No breaking API removals, but default retry behavior is now more conservative (fewer immediate retries) to reduce duplicated requests under auth-refresh race conditions.
